bitwarden.description:
Bitwarden is a free and open-source password manager that securely stores, generates, and autofills passwords, passkeys, payment cards, identities, and sensitive information.

Protect your digital life with end-to-end encryption and securely synchronize your vault across Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux, and web browsers.

Features include unlimited password storage, cross-device synchronization, a built-in password and username generator, secure autofill, biometric unlocking, passkey management, and two-factor authentication support.

Bitwarden Send allows you to securely share text and files with others, while encrypted notes and customizable vault organization help keep your information accessible and protected.

The free plan includes unlimited passwords and synchronization across devices. Optional premium and business plans provide additional features. Bitwarden also supports self-hosting for users who prefer to manage their own infrastructure.

With open-source code, independent security audits, and a privacy-focused design, Bitwarden makes it easier to use strong, unique credentials for every account.
